propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple seams, causing project disables/retunes to be ignored and activated project DET criteria to disappear, with separate reads describing inconsistent repository policy states.

A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must compile effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, and metadata into one deterministic digest-bound authority before selection or model execution.

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of non-empty globs, with ["**"] as the repository-wide unconditional selector; this rule applies only at snapshot-compile time, not in the shared _validate_applies_to validator.
The CriteriaSnapshot digest reuses the existing _overlay_signature content digest rather than inventing a parallel one, and serves as a projection derived under OperationSnapshot resolution.
Migration from applies_to: [] to applies_to: ["**"] for project.review-phase-boundaries must preserve prior unconditional-select behavior when changed_files is empty, verified by contract tests.
Existing registry APIs remain as compatibility adapters until dependent cutover; rollback is a code revert without configuration flags.
